description: How fast a large UK company pays its suppliers. From the company's statutory Payment Practices reports (OGL v3) — average days to pay, share paid late against agreed terms, terms, trend over its last reports, benchmark against all recent reporters, and a plain reading for suppliers. 1 credit. A name also returns otherMatches (other reporting companies it matches, by number).
